summary: After tapping 'Hide Tab Bar' on the Tab Bar Hidden screen, the native tab bar fully disappears: describe shows no Tab Bar group and no Albums/Contacts items, and the screenshot shows only 'Article' and the 'Show Tab Bar' button on an otherwise empty screen. Tapping 'Show Tab Bar' restores the tab bar (Article/Albums/Contacts) as a control check.
